evidence_items.description: The target includes an explicit citation to the KTP Trace Intelligence Specification v0.1.
The target follows a similar structure: trace evidence, review status, dispute check, allocation readiness, and separation from automatic payment.
Semantic comparison indicates strong overlap around evidence packets, origin candidates, review processes, and allocation-readiness gates.
Manual review confirms that the target meaningfully depends on the cited specification and correctly preserves the distinction between trace evidence and allocation.
LLM-assisted review finds that the target is suitable for allocation-readiness review, while warning that royalty calculation must remain outside this record.

analysis.summary: The target is a relatively strong trace case because it includes explicit citation, structural relevance, conceptual alignment, and no active dispute. It may proceed to allocation-readiness review.
analysis.reasoning_notes: The record demonstrates several positive readiness signals: explicit citation is present, the cited origin candidate is relevant, structural similarity is meaningful, and the record has been reviewed. However, this only supports readiness for review, not automatic allocation.
analysis.uncertainty_notes: Contribution weight, royalty share, and final allocation decision remain unresolved. Additional governance rules, tolerance bands, and allocation criteria would be required before any value distribution.

review_status.notes: The trace record has been reviewed and may proceed to allocation-readiness review. No automatic royalty allocation is authorized by this record.

allocation_readiness.reason: The record includes explicit citation, relevant structural and conceptual evidence, completed review status, and no active dispute. It is ready for allocation-readiness review, not automatic allocation.

governance.notes: This example demonstrates the boundary between being ready for allocation-readiness review and being approved for actual royalty distribution.
